get.summary: Get note content for embedding generation
Get a publicly shared note by cryptographic share token
get.description:
This endpoint does not require authentication. The token contains an embedded
organization_id (cryptographically signed) which is used to route to the correct
tenant database via serencore's service JWT API. The token is verified before use.
